java_reachability: Firefly extends NaturalistAnimal -> Animal/AgeableMob; normal Minecraft Age NBT and isBaby state select the dedicated FireflyBabyModel and baby texture. The Java class's tick path also branches on isBaby for animation behavior.
missing_engine_seam: Pinned Horizon normalizes negative Firefly Age before EntityJoinLevelEvent and entity_tick_pre/entity_tick_post can observe it. Those hooks expose entity id/kind/position but no pre-finalization NBT or spawn-NBT callback. A synced mod attachment can preserve an age after receipt, but cannot distinguish the requested juvenile Age from an adult once Horizon has replaced both with 0.
